hero.heading: LYST was created so an event isn't just organized — it becomes memorable.

mission.heading: Why LYST was created
mission.body: An invitation often only serves you up until the event. LYST turns it into a living digital space that stays with guests from the invite all the way to a shared memory.

comparisons.description: Invitations, event details, RSVPs, and guest communication come together in one place, saving time and simplifying management.
Guests get instant updates, the exact location, and can confirm attendance with ease.
Every photo, video, and voice greeting comes together in one place and is kept forever.

vision.heading: Technology that serves emotion
vision.body: We believe digital products should bring people closer together. Every feature of LYST is built to simplify the chaos of organizing so you have more time to enjoy the celebration.
vision.imageAlt: A human moment at an event
